# Vendored browser dependencies

- Marked 18.0.12: https://github.com/markedjs/marked (MIT)
- DOMPurify 3.4.15: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0)

The exact browser distributions are committed so page rendering does not depend on a runtime CDN request. License files are retained alongside them. Upgrade deliberately and repeat the Markdown rendering/security checks. Bundling a version does not remove the need for security updates.
